scenarios.desc: Agent proposes to close out work without writing a session log
scenarios.input: I finished the change and committed it. Anything left before I open the PR? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A session log is optional: nothing requires one to commit, push, or open a PR. When one IS kept, the session-policy pre-commit hook validates it (validate-if-present) and endingCommit should be recorded before the PR.

scenarios.desc: Session log written but the ending commit is left blank
scenarios.input: My session log has changesCommitted marked complete and endingCommit set to an empty string. The validator passes. Is that fine? Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: validate_session_json.py passes but warns when changesCommitted is complete and endingCommit is empty. A passing validator is not the same as a complete log.

scenarios.desc: Change touches only source files with no .agents/ paths (negative)
scenarios.input: I want to fix an off-by-one in a helper function in src/. Plan in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The session-log mechanics scope to .agents/** changes. A source-only edit touches no .agents/ path, so the rule does not apply. A session log was never required to begin with.
